verses.sloka: दत्त्वा तु सह वैदेह्या ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनम् बहु ।जग्मतुः पितरम् द्रष्टुम् सीतया सह राघवौ ॥२-३३-१॥
verses.transliteration: dattvā tu saha vaidehyā brāhmaṇebhyo dhanam bahu ।jagmatuḥ pitaram draṣṭum sītayā saha rāghavau ॥2-33-1॥

translations.english: After giving away plenty of wealth to brahmins in charity, Rama and Lakshmana along with Sita set out to see their father, king Dasaratha.

verses.sloka: ततो गृहीते दुष्प्रेक्ष्येअशोभेताम् तदा आयुधे ।माला दामभिर् आसक्ते सीतया समलम्कृते ॥२-३३-२॥
verses.transliteration: tato gṛhīte duṣprekṣyeaśobhetām tadā āyudhe ।mālā dāmabhir āsakte sītayā samalamkṛte ॥2-33-2॥

translations.english: The pair of dazzling weapons held (by Rama and Lakshmana) looked splendid decorated with flower garlands by Sita.
translations.hindi: ज के भेजे हुए सुमंत्र ने तुरन्त भीतर जा कर, वहाँ देखा कि महाराज दशरथ शोक से विकल इस हैं

verses.sloka: ततः प्रासाद हर्म्याणि विमान शिखराणि च ।अधिरुह्य जनः श्रीमान् उदासीनो व्यलोकयत् ॥२-३३-३॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prāsāda harmyāṇi vimāna śikharāṇi ca ।adhiruhya janaḥ śrīmān udāsīno vyalokayat ॥2-33-3॥

translations.english: The rich climbed their palaces and mansions, terraces of sevenstoried buildings and watched them sadly.

verses.sloka: न हि रथ्याः स्म शक्यन्ते गन्तुम् बहु जन आकुलाः ।आरुह्य तस्मात् प्रासादान् दीनाः पश्यन्ति राघवम् ॥२-३३-४॥
verses.transliteration: na hi rathyāḥ sma śakyante gantum bahu jana ākulāḥ ।āruhya tasmāt prāsādān dīnāḥ paśyanti rāghavam ॥2-33-4॥

translations.english: The streets were so thronged with multitudes of citizens that they were impassable. Therefore, people felt miserable and ascended their mansions and gazed at Rama.
translations.hindi: महापण्डित सुमंत्र ने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की चिन्ता से विकल आर अत्यन्त घबड़ाए हुए महाराज दशरथ जी को देख, हाथ जोड़ कर कहा

verses.sloka: पदातिम् वर्जितच् चत्रम् रामम् दृष्ट्वा तदा जनाः ।ऊचुर् बहु विधा वाचः शोक उपहत चेतसः ॥२-३३-५॥
verses.transliteration: padātim varjitac catram rāmam dṛṣṭvā tadā janāḥ ।ūcur bahu vidhā vācaḥ śoka upahata cetasaḥ ॥2-33-5॥

translations.english: Seeing Rama walking without the royal umbrella, people were very much shocked. They expressed their reaction in so many words:
translations.hindi: सुमंत्र ने प्रथम तो राजोचित अभिवादन किया, तढुपरान्त महाराज की जय हो कह कर, आशीबीद दिया । फिर डरते-डरते वे धीमे स्वर से यह मधुर वचन बोले

verses.sloka: यम् यान्तम् अनुयाति स्म चतुर् अन्ग बलम् महत् ।तम् एकम् सीतया सार्धम् अनुयाति स्म लक्ष्मणः ॥२-३३-६॥
verses.transliteration: yam yāntam anuyāti sma catur anga balam mahat ।tam ekam sītayā sārdham anuyāti sma lakṣmaṇaḥ ॥2-33-6॥

translations.english: Whenever Rama went out, powerful army of four divisions used to follow him. Today he is walking alone followed by Lakshmana and Sita.
translations.hindi: हे महाराज ! ये । पुरुषसिंद आपके पुत्र द्वार पर खड़े हैं । ब्राह्मणों और अपने नोकरों-चाकरों को धन ओर सामान दे

verses.sloka: ऐश्वर्यस्य रसज्ञः सन् कामिनाम् चैव कामदः ।न इच्चति एव अनृतम् कर्तुम् पितरम् धर्म गौरवात् ॥२-३३-७॥
verses.transliteration: aiśvaryasya rasajñaḥ san kāminām caiva kāmadaḥ ।na iccati eva anṛtam kartum pitaram dharma gauravāt ॥2-33-7॥

translations.english: Rama who enjoyed the comforts of affluence gratifies those who have desires. Out of veneration for righteousness, he does not want to prove his father false (to his promise).
translations.hindi: अर सब सुहज्जनों से विदा हो, सत्यपराक्रम श्रीरामचन्द्र आपके दर्शन करने के लिए आए हुए हैं

verses.sloka: या न शक्या पुरा द्रष्टुम् भूतैः आकाशगैः अपि ।ताम् अद्य सीताम् पश्यन्ति राज मार्ग गता जनाः ॥२-३३-८॥
verses.transliteration: yā na śakyā purā draṣṭum bhūtaiḥ ākāśagaiḥ api ।tām adya sītām paśyanti rāja mārga gatā janāḥ ॥2-33-8॥

translations.english: It was not possible even for the creatures wandering in the sky (birds) to have a glimpse of Sita before. Now passersby walking the highway can behold her.
translations.hindi: बर्धयित्वा _ सम्पूज्य । ( रा० ) २ सते -णदोपकरणादिकं । (गो०) चतुस्त्रिशः सगः 2 ३७१ हे ल प्रकार सूय भगवान अपनी किरणों से सुशोभित होते र ही श्रारामचन्द्र भी विविध प्रकार के राजोचित गुणों से. शोभित हैं । वे अब शीघ्र ही दराडकवन को जायेगे । सो हे प्रथ्बी- _ नाथ . आप उनको दशन दीजिए

verses.sloka: अङ्ग राग उचिताम् सीताम् रक्त चन्दन सेविनीम् ।वर्षम् उष्णम् च शीतम् च नेष्यति आशु विवर्णताम् ॥२-३३-९॥
verses.transliteration: aṅga rāga ucitām sītām rakta candana sevinīm ।varṣam uṣṇam ca śītam ca neṣyati āśu vivarṇatām ॥2-33-9॥

translations.english: Sita who used to apply fragrant unguents and smear the body with redsandal cream will now be exposed to the rain, the heat and the cold which will quickly discolour her body.

verses.sloka: अद्य नूनम् दशरथः सत्त्वम् आविश्य भाषते ।न हि राजा प्रियम् पुत्रम् विवासयितुम् अर्हति ॥२-३३-१०॥
verses.transliteration: adya nūnam daśarathaḥ sattvam āviśya bhāṣate ।na hi rājā priyam putram vivāsayitum arhati ॥2-33-10॥

translations.english: Surely king Dasaratha possessed of an evil spirit spoke the way he did today. Otherwise, should a king banish his beloved son?
translations.hindi: है सुमंत्र ! इस घर में मेरी जितनी स्त्रियाँ हैं, उन ह म सब को पहले बुला लो । मैं उन सब के सहित श्रीरामचन्द्र को देखना ` चाहता हूँ

verses.sloka: निर्गुणस्य अपि पुत्रस्या काथम् स्यात् विप्रवासनम् ।किम् पुनर् यस्य लोको अयम् जितः वृत्तेन केवलम् ॥२-३३-११॥
verses.transliteration: nirguṇasya api putrasyā kātham syāt vipravāsanam ।kim punar yasya loko ayam jitaḥ vṛttena kevalam ॥2-33-11॥

translations.english: Even a son who is bereft of virtues cannot be banished, what to say about Rama, who by good conduct alone has conquered the world.
translations.hindi: यह सुन सुमंत्र भीतर गए और स्त्रियों से बोले कि महाराज आपको बुलाते हैं --श ब्र आइए

verses.sloka: आनृशम्स्यम् अनुक्रोशः श्रुतम् शीलम् दमः शमः ।राघवम् शोभयन्ति एते षड् गुणाः पुरुष उत्तमम् ॥२-३३-१२॥
verses.transliteration: ānṛśamsyam anukrośaḥ śrutam śīlam damaḥ śamaḥ ।rāghavam śobhayanti ete ṣaḍ guṇāḥ puruṣa uttamam ॥2-33-12॥

translations.english: Harmlessness, compassion, learning, good conduct, restraint of senses and selfcontrol, all these six qualities adorn Rama, the greatest among men.
translations.hindi: जब सुमंच ने उन सब स्त्रियों को इस प्रकार महाराज की आज्ञा सुनाई, तब अपने पति की आज्ञा से वे महाराज के पास ' जाने को तैयार हुई

verses.sloka: तस्मात् तस्य उपघातेन प्रजाः परम पीडिताः ।औदकानि इव सत्त्वानि ग्रीष्मे सलिल सम्क्षयात् ॥२-३३-१३॥
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tasya upaghātena prajāḥ parama pīḍitāḥ ।audakāni iva sattvāni grīṣme salila samkṣayāt ॥2-33-13॥

translations.english: Therefore, people are deeply pained to see Rama afflicted. They look like aquatic creatures in summer when the water dries up.
translations.hindi: साढे तीन सौ स्त्रियाँ जिनके नेत्र श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के वियोग- जन्य दुःख के कारण रोते-रोते लाल हो गए थे, कौसल्या को घेर कर धीरे-धीरे महाराज के पास गइ

verses.sloka: पीडया पीडितम् सर्वम् जगद् अस्य जगत् पतेः ।मूलस्य इव उपघातेन वृक्षः पुष्प फल उपगः ॥२-३३-१४॥
verses.transliteration: pīḍayā pīḍitam sarvam jagad asya jagat pateḥ ।mūlasya iva upaghātena vṛkṣaḥ puṣpa phala upagaḥ ॥2-33-14॥

translations.english: Just as severed at the root, an entire tree along with its fruits and flowers is destroyed, similarly the whole world gets afflicted when Rama, the ruler of the world, comes to harm.
translations.hindi: इ जब महाराज ने देखा कि सब स्त्रियाँ आ गई, तब उन्होंने . सुमंत्र को आज्ञा दी कि हे सुमंत्र ! मेरे पुत्र को ले आओ

verses.sloka: मूलं ह्येष मनुष्याणाम् धर्मसारो महाद्युतिः ।पुष्पम् फलम् च पत्रम् च शाखाश्चा स्येतरे जनाः ॥२-३३-१५॥
verses.transliteration: mūlaṁ hyeṣa manuṣyāṇām dharmasāro mahādyutiḥ ।puṣpam phalam ca patram ca śākhāścā syetare janāḥ ॥2-33-15॥

translations.english: Effulgent Rama personifies the essence of dharma. He is the root of (the tree of) humanity. The other people are connected with this tree like flowers, fruit, leaves and branches.

verses.sloka: ते लक्ष्मणैव क्षिप्रम् सपत्न्यः सह बान्धवाः ।गच्चन्तम् अनुगच्चामः येन गच्चति राघवः ॥२-३३-१६॥
verses.transliteration: te lakṣmaṇaiva kṣipram sapatnyaḥ saha bāndhavāḥ ।gaccantam anugaccāmaḥ yena gaccati rāghavaḥ ॥2-33-16॥

translations.english: Let all of us without delay along with our wives and relations follow Rama, like Lakshmana, wherever he goes.
translations.hindi: उस समय महाराज, दूर ही से हाथ जोड़े हुए श्रीरामचन्द्र को आते देख, तुरन्त पलंग छोड़, स्त्रियों सहित उठ खड़े हुए

verses.sloka: उद्यानानि परित्यज्य क्षेत्राणि च गृहाणि च ।एक दुह्ख सुखा रामम् अनुगच्चाम धार्मिकम् ॥२-३३-१७॥
verses.transliteration: udyānāni parityajya kṣetrāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca ।eka duhkha sukhā rāmam anugaccāma dhārmikam ॥2-33-17॥

translations.english: Deserting our gardens, fields and houses and experiencing the same joy and sorrow of the virtuous Rama, we shall follow him.
translations.hindi: आर श्रीरामचन्द्र को देख उनकी ओर बड़े वेग से ढौडे; . किन्तु श्रीरामचन्द्र के पास तक न पहुँच, बीच ही में दुःखी होने | के कारण मूर्छित हो, धरणी पर गिर पड़े

verses.sloka: समुद्धृत निधानानि परिध्वस्त अजिराणि च ।उपात्त धन धान्यानि हृत साराणि सर्वशः ॥२-३३-१८॥
verses.transliteration: samuddhṛta nidhānāni paridhvasta ajirāṇi ca ।upātta dhana dhānyāni hṛta sārāṇi sarvaśaḥ ॥2-33-18॥

translations.english: Let Kaikeyi take possession of our deserted and dilapidated homes with ruined courtyards which seem as though struck by calamities. They are drained of wealth and foodgrains, covered with dust and abandoned by the gods. There is no water or smoke (from kitchen). They are infested with rats. They stand unswept. There foodgrains lie around ratholes, and broken earthenwares lie scattered. There are no offerings, no sacrifices, no recitation of sacred hymns, no libations and no invocations.
translations.hindi: यह देख श्रीरामचन्द्र और लक्ष्मण ने बड़ी तेजी से दौड़ कर, दुःख ओर शोक से चेष्टाशून्य-से हुए महाराज को उठा लिया

verses.sloka: रजसा अभ्यवकीर्णानि परित्यक्तानि दैवतैः ।मूषकैः परिधावद्भिरुद्बिलैरावृतानि च ॥२-३३-१९॥
verses.transliteration: rajasā abhyavakīrṇāni parityaktāni daivataiḥ ।mūṣakaiḥ paridhāvadbhirudbilairāvṛtāni ca ॥2-33-19॥

translations.english: Let Kaikeyi take possession of our deserted and dilapidated homes with ruined courtyards which seem as though struck by calamities. They are drained of wealth and foodgrains, covered with dust and abandoned by the gods. There is no water or smoke (from kitchen). They are infested with rats. They stand unswept. There foodgrains lie around ratholes, and broken earthenwares lie scattered. There are no offerings, no sacrifices, no recitation of sacred hymns, no libations and no invocations.

verses.sloka: अपेतोदकधूमानि हीनसम्मार्जनानि च ।प्रनष्टबलिकर्मेज्यमन्त्रहोमजपानि च ॥२-३३-२०॥
verses.transliteration: apetodakadhūmāni hīnasammārjanāni ca ।pranaṣṭabalikarmejyamantrahomajapāni ca ॥2-33-20॥

translations.english: Let Kaikeyi take possession of our deserted and dilapidated homes with ruined courtyards which seem as though struck by calamities. They are drained of wealth and foodgrains, covered with dust and abandoned by the gods. There is no water or smoke (from kitchen). They are infested with rats. They stand unswept. There foodgrains lie around ratholes, and broken earthenwares lie scattered. There are no offerings, no sacrifices, no recitation of sacred hymns, no libations and no invocations.

verses.sloka: दुष्कालेनेव भग्नानि भिभाजनवन्ति च ।अस्मत् त्यक्तानि वेश्मानि कैकेयी प्रतिपद्यताम् ॥२-३३-२१॥
verses.transliteration: duṣkāleneva bhagnāni bhibhājanavanti ca ।asmat tyaktāni veśmāni kaikeyī pratipadyatām ॥2-33-21॥

translations.english: Let Kaikeyi take possession of our deserted and dilapidated homes with ruined courtyards which seem as though struck by calamities. They are drained of wealth and foodgrains, covered with dust and abandoned by the gods. There is no water or smoke (from kitchen). They are infested with rats. They stand unswept. There foodgrains lie around ratholes, and broken earthenwares lie scattered. There are no offerings, no sacrifices, no recitation of sacred hymns, no libations and no invocations.
translations.hindi: जब एक मुहूत्त बाद महाराज सचेत हुए, तब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी शोकसमुद्र में डूबे हुए महाराज दशरथ से हाथ जोड़ कर बोले

verses.sloka: वनम् नगरम् एव अस्तु येन गच्चति राघवः ।अस्माभिः च परित्यक्तम् पुरम् सम्पद्यताम् वनम् ॥२-३३-२२॥
verses.transliteration: vanam nagaram eva astu yena gaccati rāghavaḥ ।asmābhiḥ ca parityaktam puram sampadyatām vanam ॥2-33-22॥

translations.english: Since the scion of the Raghu race is going to the forest, let that forest itself be our city and let the city deserted by us become the forest.
translations.hindi: कुशलेन--चल्नुप्रेतिशेषः | ( गो० ) डे महाराज ! मैं आपसे बिदा होने आया हुँ । आप हम सरके स्वामी हैं । अब में दरडकबन को प्रस्थान करता हूँ | अब आप मेरी ओर एक बार कृपादृष्टि से देख तो ले

verses.sloka: बिलानि दम्ष्ट्रिणः सर्वे सानूनि मृग पक्षिणः ।अस्मत् त्यक्तम् प्रपद्यन्ताम् सेव्यमानम् त्यजन्तु च ॥२-३३-२३॥
verses.transliteration: bilāni damṣṭriṇaḥ sarve sānūni mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ ।asmat tyaktam prapadyantām sevyamānam tyajantu ca ॥2-33-23॥

translations.english: Let all the fanged creatures leave their lairs, birds and animals the mountain slopes, lions and elephants, their haunts due to the fear caused by our presence and occupy the city left by us (on seeing us deserting).
translations.hindi: लक्ष्मण थोर सीता को भी मेरे साथ जाने की आज्ञा दीजिए, क्योंकि मैने अनेक कारण बतला, इन दोनों ही को मना किया, परन्तु ये दोनों यहाँ रहने को राजी ही नहीं होते

verses.sloka: इति एवम् विविधा वाचो नाना जन समीरिताः ।तृणमाम्सफलादानाम् देशम् व्यालमृगद्विजम् ॥२-३३-२४॥
verses.transliteration: iti evam vividhā vāco nānā jana samīritāḥ ।tṛṇamāmsaphalādānām deśam vyālamṛgadvijam ॥2-33-24॥

translations.english: Let Kaikeyi along with her son and her relatives acquire that country which will be inhabited by birds and animals living on grass, fruits, and flesh. Withdrawn, we shall happily live in the forest along with Rama.
translations.hindi: सो हे महाराज ! शोक को परित्याग कर, हम सब को वैसे ही आज्ञा दीजिए जैसे प्रजापति अपनी प्रजा को आज्ञा देते हैं

verses.sloka: प्रपद्यताम् हि कैकेयी सपुत्रा सहबान्धवैः ।राघावेण वने सर्वे सह वत्स्याम निर्वृताः ॥२-३३-२५॥
verses.transliteration: prapadyatām hi kaikeyī saputrā sahabāndhavaiḥ ।rāghāveṇa vane sarve saha vatsyāma nirvṛtāḥ ॥2-33-25॥

translations.english: Let Kaikeyi along with her son and her relatives acquire that country which will be inhabited by birds and animals living on grass, fruits, and flesh. Withdrawn, we shall happily live in the forest along with Rama.
translations.hindi: तब महाराज दशरथ व्यग्रता रहित अपने पुत्र को बन जाने को आज्ञा की प्रतीक्षा करते जान, उनकी ओर कृपापूर्ण इष्टि से. देख, बोले

verses.sloka: इत्येवम् विविधा वाचो नानाजनसमीरिताः।शुश्राव रामः श्रुत्वा च न विचक्रे अस्य मानसम् ॥२-३३-२६॥
verses.transliteration: ityevam vividhā vāco nānājanasamīritāḥ।śuśrāva rāmaḥ śrutvā ca na vicakre asya mānasam ॥2-33-26॥

translations.english: Such were the various words uttered by the people. Even after hearing them his (Rama's) mind remained unmoved (from his resolve).

verses.sloka: स तु वेश्म पितुर्दूरा त्कैलासशिखरप्रभम् ।अभिचक्राम धर्मात्मा मत्तमातङ्गविक्रमः ॥२-३३-२७॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu veśma piturdūrā tkailāsaśikharaprabham ।abhicakrāma dharmātmā mattamātaṅgavikramaḥ ॥2-33-27॥

translations.english: Dutiful Rama, endowed with the prowess of an intoxicated elephant, approached the residence of his father that resembled from a distance the peak of mount Kailasa in splendour.
translations.hindi: महाराज का यह बचन सुन धमधुरन्धर और बातचीत करने में पटु श्रीरामचन्द्र जी हाथ जोड़ कर, पिता से बोले

verses.sloka: विनीतवीरपुरुषं प्रविश्य तु नृपालयम् ।ददर्शवस्थितम् दीनम् सुमन्त्रमविदूरतः ॥२-३३-२८॥
verses.transliteration: vinītavīrapuruṣaṁ praviśya tu nṛpālayam ।dadarśavasthitam dīnam sumantramavidūrataḥ ॥2-33-28॥

translations.english: Rama entered the royal palace guarded by welltrained warriors and not from very far saw Sumantra who stood a picture of dejection.

verses.sloka: प्रतीक्षमाणो अभिजनम् तदा आर्तम् ।अनार्त रूपः प्रहसन्न् इव अथ।जगाम रामः पितरम् दिदृक्षुः ।पितुर् निदेशम् विधिवच् चिकीर्षुः ॥२-३३-२९॥
verses.transliteration: pratīkṣamāṇo abhijanam tadā ārtam ।anārta rūpaḥ prahasann iva atha।jagāma rāmaḥ pitaram didṛkṣuḥ ।pitur nideśam vidhivac cikīrṣuḥ ॥2-33-29॥

translations.english: Even after observing the people in grief, Rama did not reveal his sorrowful feelings. Bound by duty he went in as if with a smile to see his father.

verses.sloka: तत् पूर्वम् ऐक्ष्वाक सुतः महात्मा ।रामः गमिष्यन् वनम् आर्त रूपम् ।व्यतिष्ठत प्रेक्ष्य तदा सुमन्त्रम् ।पितुर् महात्मा प्रतिहारण अर्थम् ॥२-३३-३०॥
verses.transliteration: tat pūrvam aikṣvāka sutaḥ mahātmā ।rāmaḥ gamiṣyan vanam ārta rūpam ।vyatiṣṭhata prekṣya tadā sumantram ।pitur mahātmā pratihāraṇa artham ॥2-33-30॥

translations.english: Seeing Sumantra stricken with grief for the first time the magnanimous Rama, scion of the Ikshvaku dynasty, on the way to the forest waited there for his father to be informed of his arrival.
translations.hindi: सत्यरूपी पाश में बंधे, ओर इशारे से केकेयी द्वारा प्रेरित हो, महाराज आत हो और रोदन करते हुए श्रीरामचंद्र जी से ले

verses.sloka: पितुर्निदेशेन तु धर्मवत्सलो ।वन प्रवेशे कृत बुद्धि निश्चयः ।स राघवः प्रेक्ष्य सुमन्त्रम् अब्रवीन् ।निवेदयस्व आगमनम् नृपाय मे ॥२-३३-३१॥
verses.transliteration: piturnideśena tu dharmavatsalo ।vana praveśe kṛta buddhi niścayaḥ ।sa rāghavaḥ prekṣya sumantram abravīn ।nivedayasva āgamanam nṛpāya me ॥2-33-31॥

translations.english: Rama, lover of righteousness, determined to go to the forest in obedience to his father's command said to Sumantra, Inform the king of my arrival. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रयस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtythird sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: हे वत्स ! पारलौकिक सुख ओर इस लोक के यश आदि फल की प्राप्ति तथा फिर यहाँ लौट आने के लिए तुम अव्यग्न मन से बन जाओ | माग में तुम्हारा कल्याण हो और तुम्हें किसी भी बनेले जीव-जन्तु का भय न हो
